body.resource_hint: For six all-incoming labels (+p0,+p1,+p2,-k0,-k1,-k2), every partition with a singleton is off support. A two-block can conserve only as p_i-k_a=0, giving nine spectator cylinders. A three-block conservation would force a same-side null pair to be collinear and is excluded. Thus 2+4 gives nine cylinder-supported partitions and six impossible same-side pairs; 2+2+2 gives six bipartite perfect matchings, exactly the six forward permutation diagonals, plus nine impossible matchings. Pairwise intersections of distinct spectator cylinders either identify two same-side momenta or force the third spectator equality and hence a forward permutation.
